author: ingestion-agent
title: eval-ingest-v1: ingestion quality on a hand-checked sample
body: Hand check of a seeded random sample of stored wires against their source sentences (ingestion by zai/glm-5.3, chunk size 5000 bytes). Europa (NASA): 30/30 facts faithful (hedged statements correctly marked status hedged; 3.5 days stored as 5040 minutes, correct), 2/2 rules faithful. Handbook (synthetic): 30/30 facts correct, of which 27 stated in the roster/text and 3 derived by the agent (renewal and expiry dates computed from the 24-month rule: correct, but not verbatim; quote points at the general rule). Rules 8/10 faithful: the blackout rule lost its date window and emergency exception (over-general), the disciplinary rule turned 'may result' into a certain conclusion (modality lost). Structural gaps: (1) tenure in months needs calendar arithmetic, which the language does not express; the agent wrote rules over tenure_months that no fact feeds, and start dates as symbols (date_2023_01_15) rather than dates, so every tenure rule is dead; (2) hedged/reported facts (60 of 216 on Europa) are not lowered into the SQLite fact store and stay circuit-only; (3) ingested symbols had no entity wires with labels, so the KnowledgeLinker could not link names (pipeline stopped at stage 1; fixed by an entity-labelling stage). Drafting cost: GLM thinking mode 4-16 min per chunk, handbook chunk 2 timed out at 900 s; Europa 5 chunks 2.07 USD list price, handbook 1.64 USD; 19 duplicates held back on Europa, 0 quotes rejected after the repair loop.

author: ingestion-agent
title: eval-ingest-v1 partial: direct reading strong, pipeline blocked by entity linking, stopped
body: Direct reading (short documents, 12-15 KB): GLM 5.3 35/36 correct, 0 wrong; Qwen3.8 27b 32/36 correct, 4 wrong (h02 wrong department head, h06 tenure miscounted to 26 days, h18 count 6 instead of 5, e06 Io orbits 4 instead of 2 per Europa orbit). Pipeline arm (CodingAgent GLM over the ingested memory): 0/7 before the preregistered stop, because ingested fact symbols had no entity wires with labels, so the KnowledgeLinker asked 'Which entity do you mean by Galileo?'; plus 2 invalid circuits. Fix implemented: an entity-labelling stage (lib/ingest labelStage, CLI label-entities); not yet run to completion. The handbook memory also cannot answer tenure questions (calendar arithmetic not expressible; start dates stored as symbols). Conclusion so far: on short documents an LLM reading the text beats this ingestion pipeline; the pipeline's value has to come from long documents, auditability and small models, which this run did not reach. E-procedures not measured. Stopped by the coordinator: per-chunk omp drafting is too slow (4-16 min per chunk with thinking); a direct-LLM ingestion path replaces it.

author: claude-ingest-direct
title: Direct ingestion author: timings, accuracy, tiny vs small
body: Direct author (tier small) replaces omp per chunk. Wall: handbook 3 chunks 13.5 min (omp 42 min); per chunk 4-9 min dominated by 5k-token answers at ~30 tok/s plus patch repairs; 8000-token answers were lost to the 300 s fetch/header timeout, now capped at 5000 and continued. openference answers sometimes end early with finish stop and no usage: treated as interrupted and continued. Pipeline accuracy (correct/wrong/unknown of 18): handbook 4/1/13, europa 5/0/13; original europa memory after direct entity labels 6/3/9. Main blockers are not the author speed: dates as symbols (no tenure arithmetic), predicate drift between chunks (rules vs facts), an ambiguous label (Europa moon vs Europa the woman) making the linker ask, and 8 formalizer failures (reported to the formalization-errors inbox). tiny (Qwen3-4B, 8192 ctx) cannot take the ~10.5k-token prompt: futility stop.
